data.name: Mughamir
data.gender_notes: Mughamir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who strikes with great force, a warrior, a fighter. Derived from the Arabic root 'gh-m-r' meaning 'to strike'. The name Mughamir carries the meaning “Fighter, Warrior” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mughamir usually hope their child will grow to embody fighter, warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies courage and determination, inspired by the warriors of Islam.
data.etymology: Mughamir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fighter, Warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mughamir total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: مغامر
in_arabic.meaning: الشخص الذي يغادر الحدود ويتخطى القيود ويكون جريئًا
in_arabic.long_meaning: مغامر هو الشخص الذي يتحلى بالشجاعة والإقدام على المخاطر، يتخطى الحدود ويخرج عن المألوف، ويكون على استعداد دائمًا للمواجهة والتحدي. يأتي اسم مغامر من الجذر العربي 'غ-م-ر' الذي يحمل معاني المغامرة والجرأة والشجاعة. يستخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية لوصف الشخص الذي يتحلى بالروح الجريئة والمغامر.

in_urdu.name: مغامر
in_urdu.meaning: وہ شخص جو ہمت اور جرأت کا مظاہرہ کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مغامر وہ شخص ہوتا ہے جو اپنی ہمت اور جرأت کے ذریعے دوسروں سے الگ نظر آتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی جڑ 'غ-م-ر' سے نکلا ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں مغامرت، ہمت، اور جرأت۔ اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام ایک ایسے شخص کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو جرئ اور نڈر ہو، اور ہمیشہ نئے چیلنجز کا سامنا کرنے کے لئے تیار رہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुग़ामिर
in_hindi.meaning: जो व्यक्ति साहस और बहादुरी दिखाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुग़ामिर वह व्यक्ति होता है जो अपने साहस और बहादुरी के कारण पहचाना जाता है। यह नाम अरबी मूल 'غ-م-ر' से आया है, जिसका अर्थ है साहस, बहादुरी, और जोखिम उठाने की भावना। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उस व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो निडर और जुर्रत वाला होता है, और हमेशा नए चुनौतियों का सामना करने के लिए तैयार रहता है।

in_pashto.name: مغامر
in_pashto.meaning: هغه کس چې زړور او جرأت نښه کوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: مغامر هغه کس دی چې خپله زړورتیا او جرأت ښیي. دا نوم د عربي ريښې 'غ-م-ر' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د جرأت، زړورتیا، او خطر منونکي دي. د افغان او پښتون دودیزو کې، دا نوم د هغه چا لپاره کارول کیږي چې پرته له وېرې او ډرې وي، او تل د نويو ننګونو سره مخ کیدو ته چمتو وي.

in_english.name: Mughamir
in_english.meaning: One who shows courage and boldness
in_english.long_meaning: Mughamir is derived from the Arabic root 'غ-م-ر' (Ghayn-Mim-Ra), which conveys meanings of courage, boldness, and risk-taking. In Islamic tradition, the name signifies a person who is fearless, daring, and always ready to face new challenges. Historically, individuals with this name have been admired for their bravery and willingness to venture into the unknown. The name Mughamir is associated with positive personality traits such as confidence, determination, and a pioneering spirit.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Mughamir" has significant cultural impact in Islamic history. It is a name of valor and bravery, evoking images of powerful warriors and fearless fighters. This name would have been given to a child as a source of inspiration and pride, emphasizing the importance of strength and resilience. It also highlights the notion of jihad, or struggle, which is a central tenet in Islam, and encourages individuals to stand up for their beliefs no matter the cost.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Mughamir" holds deep meaning as it reflects the inner warrior within each individual. It is a reminder of the spiritual battle that we all face in our daily lives as we strive to adhere to the teachings of Islam and live a virtuous life. The name Mughamir serves as a source of inspiration and motivation, reminding us of the strength and power that we possess within ourselves to overcome adversity and challenge. Ultimately, it is a call to action, encouraging us to be warriors in the pursuit of knowledge, faith, and righteousness.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Mughamir was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad who participated in the Battle of Uhud. The name Mughamir carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mughamir was a prominent warrior during the Battle of Uhud, which took place in 625 CE. He is believed to have been a member of the Ansar tribe, which supported the early Muslim community in Medina.
